[[File:"Torment Dude" concept art.jpg|thumb|300px|Concept art by [[Kekai Kotaki]].]] The [[torment creature]]s are [[demon]]ic entities that aided [[Abaddon]] in bringing about [[Nightfall (event)|Nightfall]]. They were the primary forces used during the destruction of the [[Tomb of the Primeval Kings]] and the [[Dragon Festival 2006|Dragon Festival]] along with being the first wave of forces once [[portal]]s began appearing throughout [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]], such as in [[Sunspears in Kryta|Lion's Arch]], [[Sunspears in Cantha|Kaineng City]], and [[Bad Tide Rising|Kamadan]].
